summary:
Five defects found and fixed across four rungs:

**Defect 1 — R02: ESTOP_LATCH cleared without RESET (violated S5)**
Original: `RESET ESTOP_LATCH WHEN NOT ESTOP`
The latch dropped the moment the mushroom button was released, with no RESET press required.
Fix: `RESET ESTOP_LATCH WHEN RISE(RESET) AND NOT ESTOP` — mirrors the FAULT-reset condition.

**Defect 2 — R03: Jam timer never fired while belt was running (violated S7)**
Original: `TON T_JAM(PE_IN AND NOT MOTOR, 3s)`
The condition `NOT MOTOR` meant the timer only ran when the belt was already stopped — a real jam (box stuck while belt moves) was never detected.
Fix: `TON T_JAM(PE_IN AND MOTOR, 3s)` — accumulates when a box is present AND the motor is running.

**Defect 3 — R06 (seal-in): Guard re-close auto-restarted motor without START (violated S4)**
Original seal-in: `(RISE(START) OR RUN) AND NOT STOP AND NOT ESTOP AND NOT ESTOP_LATCH AND NOT FAULT`
Opening the guard did not drop RUN, so when the guard re-closed the motor restarted automatically.
Fix: add `AND GUARD_CLOSED` to both the set and seal-in paths: `(RISE(START) AND GUARD_CLOSED OR RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED) AND ...` — RUN is dropped whenever the guard opens, and START is only accepted while the guard is already closed.

**Defect 4 — R06 (ESTOP path): ESTOP release auto-restarted motor without START (violated S4/S5)**
Because D1 (R02) cleared ESTOP_LATCH on ESTOP release, and RUN was only gated on `NOT ESTOP` (live signal), RUN immediately re-sealed when ESTOP went low. Fixed as a side-effect of Defect 1 (latch now persists until RESET) combined with the existing `NOT ESTOP_LATCH` term in R06.

**Defect 5 — R08: Motor stop at pick position used 1.2 s debounce timer, causing box overshoot (violated S6)**
Original: `MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT T_END.Q`
T_END had a 1.2 s preset. At 0.5 m/s the box travels 0.6 m after PE_END fires, overshooting the 0.3 m of remaining belt and falling off.
Fix: `MOTOR = RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED AND NOT PE_END` — belt stops immediately when the box reaches the pick position.

steps.title: Read machine spec and operating rules
steps.detail:
MACHINE
Inputs: START, STOP, RESET (momentary push buttons, 1 while pressed), ESTOP (1 while the mushroom
button is pressed in), GUARD_CLOSED (1 when the interlocked guard door is closed), PE_IN (photo-eye at the
infeed, 1 when a box is in front of it), PE_END (photo-eye at the pick position).
Outputs: MOTOR (belt drive), LAMP_GREEN, LAMP_AMBER, LAMP_RED (stack light).
Plant: the belt is 4.0 m long and moves at 0.5 m/s while MOTOR = 1. Boxes are 0.4 m long, placed at the
infeed (x = 0.2 m). PE_IN sits at x = 0.3 m, PE_END at x = 3.7 m. A robot picks boxes waiting at PE_END.
The PLC scans every 0.1 s.

CONTROL LANGUAGE
Each rung is one statement; rungs run top to bottom every 0.1 s scan.
  COIL = expr                  assign (every scan)
  SET COIL WHEN expr           latch on
  RESET COIL WHEN expr         latch off
  TON T_NAME(expr, 3.0s)       on-delay timer; T_NAME.Q is 1 once expr has been 1 for the preset time
expr uses NOT, AND, OR, parentheses, TRUE/FALSE, signal names, T_NAME.Q and RISE(X) (1 for the scan in
which X goes from 0 to 1). A coil read before the rung that writes it holds its value from the previous
scan. Inputs cannot be written. Limits: 24 rungs, 12 internal coils, 4 timers, presets 0.1-10 s,
12 contacts per rung.

OPERATING RULES
S1 E-stop stops the belt [safety]: While the E-stop (ESTOP) is pressed, MOTOR must be off in the same scan.
S2 Open guard stops the belt [safety]: While the guard door is open (GUARD_CLOSED = 0), MOTOR must be off.
S3 STOP dominates [safety]: While STOP is pressed, MOTOR must be off, even if START is pressed in the same scan.
S4 No automatic restart [safety]: After any stop (STOP, E-stop, guard opened, or a fault shown on LAMP_RED) the belt may only run again after a new START press (rising edge). Pausing for a box at the pick position is not a stop: the belt resumes by itself once the robot has picked the box.
S5 E-stop needs a reset [safety]: Once the E-stop has been pressed, LAMP_RED must stay on and MOTOR off until the E-stop is released AND RESET is pressed (rising edge). A RESET press while the E-stop is still pressed does not count.
S6 Stop at the pick position [safety]: While PE_END sees a box (the pick position), MOTOR must be off in the same scan, or the box is pushed off the end of the belt (the end is 0.4 m past the point where PE_END first sees a box, which is 0.8 s at belt speed).
S7 Jam supervision [safety]: If PE_IN stays blocked for 3.0 s while MOTOR runs (a jam, or a stuck sensor), the conveyor must stop, latch a fault shown on LAMP_RED, and stay stopped until PE_IN is clear and RESET is pressed, then START. Checked in simulation: MOTOR and PE_IN on together for more than 3.5 s is a violation.
F1 START runs the belt [functional]: With the guard closed, no E-stop and no fault, a START press runs MOTOR immediately.
F2 Deliver and resume [functional]: Boxes travel to the pick position and wait there with LAMP_AMBER on; after the robot picks a box the belt resumes without a new START.
F3 No false jam alarms [functional]: A box waiting at the infeed while the belt is stopped is normal and must never raise a fault.
F4 Lamps [functional]: LAMP_GREEN = belt running; LAMP_AMBER = in run mode but paused for a box at the pick position; LAMP_RED = E-stop latched or fault.

I now have a complete root-cause analysis. Let me document all four defects before writing the patch:

---

## Root-cause analysis

| # | Rung | Symptom | Root cause |
|---|------|---------|------------|
| **D1** | **R02** | S5 violated — E-stop latch clears the moment ESTOP is released, without RESET | `RESET ESTOP_LATCH WHEN NOT ESTOP` clears on the falling edge of ESTOP alone. Must require `RISE(RESET)` too. |
| **D2** | **R06** | S4 violated — motor auto-restarts after guard re-closes or after E-stop clears | `RUN` is only gated by `NOT ESTOP` (live signal), not by `NOT ESTOP_LATCH`. When ESTOP goes low, ESTOP_LATCH also clears (D1), so RUN immediately re-seals. Fix: gate RUN on `NOT ESTOP_LATCH` **and** fix D1 so the latch persists until RESET. |
| **D3** | **R06** | S4 violated — guard re-close auto-restarts motor | `RUN` is never dropped when GUARD_CLOSED goes away; the seal-in keeps RUN=1 through a guard-open event. Must add `AND GUARD_CLOSED` to the RUN seal-in (or drop RUN when guard opens). |
| **D4** | **R03** | S7 violated — jam timer never fires while MOTOR=1 | Timer condition is `PE_IN AND NOT MOTOR`. When the belt is running and PE_IN is stuck, MOTOR=1 so the condition is false and the timer never accumulates. The jam condition should be `PE_IN AND MOTOR` (box present while belt is moving and not clearing). |
| **D5** | **R07** | S6 violated — T_END debounce is 1.2 s, so motor runs for 1.2 s after box arrives at pick position | The box arrives, PE_END goes high, but MOTOR only stops after T_END.Q fires at 1.2 s. The belt is 4 m, pick position is at 3.7 m — only 0.3 m of clearance. At 0.5 m/s the box travels 0.6 m in 1.2 s and falls off. The timer preset must be short enough that the box doesn't overshoot. The spec says PE_END is at 3.7 m and the belt ends at 4.0 m — 0.3 m clearance / 0.5 m/s = 0.6 s max. A debounce of 0 s (stop immediately on PE_END) is correct; the timer should be removed or set to 0. Looking at the scan table: PE_END goes high at t=7.6 s but MOTOR stays on until T_END.Q fires at t=8.8 s (1.2 s later) — box drops off at t=8.4 s. The fix: stop the motor as soon as PE_END is seen (remove T_END from MOTOR rung, use `NOT PE_END` directly). |

Now I'll apply all fixes in one patch (4 edits):

steps.detail: The S4 counterexample: START is pressed while GUARD_CLOSED=0 (scan 0), RUN becomes 1. On scan 1 GUARD_CLOSED=1 and MOTOR turns on — but no START press happened on scan 1. The issue is that `RUN AND GUARD_CLOSED` in the seal-in keeps RUN alive across the scan where GUARD_CLOSED transitions from 0→1 after a START that was pressed while the guard was open. The fix: START must only be accepted when GUARD_CLOSED is already true (gate `RISE(START)` on `GUARD_CLOSED`).
